comments: Registered as one bank on the footing line: the pivot x is the centre of the footing stones, not the crop centre (the loaf sign hangs left of the wall).

The lit crop has the ajar door three source pixels below the footing line; a reviewed sub-crop ends it on the footing line shared with the other two, so the one scale and baseline hold. Nothing is repainted.
geometry: The footprint, the door tile and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: pale blue-grey glass is day-0, indigo glass with shuttered ground-floor windows is night-0, amber windows with the door ajar is lit-0. The crops are tight and separated by empty columns (checked against the sheet's alpha), so none is merged.

pieces.label: day-0: plain pale blue-grey glass, door shut, lantern dark.
pieces.name: day-0

pieces.label: night-0: dark indigo glass, ground-floor windows shuttered, door shut, lantern dark.
pieces.name: night-0

pieces.label: lit-0: amber windows, door ajar with an amber slice, amber lantern.
pieces.name: lit-0

size_basis: native canvas 64x76, anchor bottom-centre (32,76); the bottom edge is the footprint's south edge; stage 384x224; a knight is 16x24 in this town; buildings may stand taller than their footprint.
timing: day 12, night 12, lit 12 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox.
